notes.title: Now Available on Steam - The Bonfire: Forsaken Lands, 20% off!
notes.content:
The Bonfire: Forsaken Lands is Now Available on Steam and is 20% off!*

Build, discover, craft and survive.Build your settlement in a snowy encampment, survive monster attacks and manage resources to uncover the secrets of the ancients.

*Offer ends March 16 at 10AM Pacific Time

notes.content:
